items.headline: Foxconn: AI Will Boost Consumer Electronics
items.excerpt: Foxconn Rotating CEO Michael Chiang says AI industry will boost the consumer electronics business. In an exclusive conversation with Bloomberg's Annabelle Droulers, Chiang says that in-region manufacturing is more critical. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Intel Suffers Worst Stock Thrashing in Decades on Weak Forecast
items.excerpt: Intel Corp. suffered its worst stock rout in more than four decades after the PC industry slump and supply-chain snags hurt its forecast, renewing fears about the chipmaker’s turnaround bid.

items.headline: Amazon Taps $80 Billion Supplier Loan Facility to Help Fund AI
items.excerpt: Amazon.com Inc. has set up supplier financing arrangements to borrow as much as $80 billion against the value of hardware it buys, the company’s latest move to preserve financial flexibility as it spends hundreds of billions on artificial intelligence infrastructure.

items.headline: ECB’s Lane Says AI Significant Contributor to Euro-Area Growth
items.excerpt: European Central Bank Chief Economist Philip Lane said the euro zone economy is being buoyed by artificial intelligence as companies invest in the technology and benefit from its rollout across the globe.

items.headline: Binance’s $6.3 Billion Cyber Heist Shows Crypto Vulnerabilities
items.excerpt: Binance, the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange, has suffered the industry’s biggest-ever hack, with $6.3 billion worth of funds affected and $3 billion in crypto frozen. items.headline: Anthropic's S1 | Google's AI Problem | The Rundown
items.excerpt: We finally got the S1 filing from Anthropic and Google had a pretty bad week. Ed Ludlow has "The Rundown" from Bloomberg Tech. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Binance Heist Shows Power of Suspected North Korean Hackers
items.excerpt: The record-setting $6.3 billion hack of Binance, the world’s biggest cryptocurrency exchange, has been blamed on alleged North Korean hackers, who have become infamous for preying on the digital-asset industry.

items.headline: Largest US Grid Seeks to Hold Data Center Power Auction in March
items.excerpt: America’s largest grid operator is planning a special auction in March to secure new generating capacity for data-center demand if federal regulators approve revised rules governing who pays.

items.headline: Binance Suspends Deposits, Withdrawals After $6.3 Billion Hack Shakes Industry
items.excerpt: Hackers siphoned off $6.3 billion from crypto exchange Binance in the biggest heist that the digital-asset industry has ever faced, the latest in a slew of security incidents afflicting the financial sector.

items.headline: CEE Is Top AI Diversifier for Morgan Stanley’s Psaila
items.excerpt: Central and Eastern Europe offers one of the most attractive opportunities in emerging markets as investors look to diversify from the artificial intelligence trade, supported by improving ties with the European Union and a growing pipeline of investment, according to Morgan Stanley’s Paul Psaila.

items.headline: Ambani’s Reliance Beats Net Estimate on Robust Refining, Jio
items.excerpt: Reliance Industries Ltd.’s quarterly earnings beat analyst estimates, driven by robust margins from refining crude oil into fuels and a strong showing by its telecom unit, which made a blockbuster stock-market debut this week.

items.headline: Binance Hack: How Do Hackers Steal Crypto? Can the Funds Be Recovered?
items.excerpt: The biggest cryptocurrency hack on record has raised fresh questions about the industry’s ability to protect digital assets and become part of mainstream financial infrastructure. items.headline: Roblox Shares Fall After Reporting Daily User Decline
items.excerpt: Roblox Corp. reported a year-over-year decline in player engagement after deploying more robust child-safety measures.

items.headline: Big Tech’s $750 Billion AI Bet Confronts Slowing Core Growth
items.excerpt: The core businesses of America’s technology giants — the advertising, consumer and retail machines propping up a collective $750 billion in artificial intelligence spending this year — are starting to show signs of slowing. items.headline: AstraZeneca CFO on AI, Earnings, Restructuring Plan
items.excerpt: AstraZeneca Chief Financial Officer Aradhana Sarin says the drug company uses AI in almost every aspect of the work they do. She talks beating on earnings, their drug pipeline and how the company approaches dealmaking. She speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Why Electronic Arts Shut Down BioWare And Cancelled ‘Mass Effect’
items.excerpt: Facing financial pressure, the video-game publisher chose ‘Star Wars’ over ‘Mass Effect’

items.headline: Reddit Plunges 25% on Plan to Limit Access, Sales Outlook Miss
items.excerpt: Reddit Inc. had its biggest share drop since its 2024 initial public offering, after saying it is planning to limit access to its online forums.

items.headline: Foxconn Chairman: AI Demand is Real
items.excerpt: Foxconn, also known as Hon Hai, is counting on a steady US expansion and a partnership with OpenAI to help hit its goal of capturing half the AI server market within two years. items.headline: Tech Stocks Tumble as Amazon Adds to AI Spending Fears
items.excerpt: Tech stocks plunged at the market open on Friday for the second day in a row as fears around AI spending collide with disappointing earnings in big tech’s core businesses.
